standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies 0 -> O_X^* -> f_*O_{X'}^* -> x_*k^* -> 0 with the ab^{-1} map, and the Leray bound H^1(X, f_*O_{X'}^*) subset H^1(X', O_{X'}^*).

standard_prerequisites.name: Regular functions on proper reduced schemes
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies global regular functions on a reduced connected proper scheme with k over an algebraically closed field, forcing ab^{-1} to vanish in the same-component case.

core_obligations: Surjectivity and kernel identification (proof lines 3333-3346): Pic(X) -> Pic(X') is surjective, and the units sequence plus the Leray inclusion identify the kernel with the cokernel of ab^{-1}: H^0(X', O_{X'}^*) -> k^*.

Two cases (proof lines 3347-3359): if a and b lie on different connected components the map ab^{-1} is surjective and the kernel is zero; if X' is proper with a, b on the same component, every global regular function is a scalar, so ab^{-1} is the zero map and k^* injects into Pic(X).
proof_roadmap: Establish surjectivity of the Picard map from the birational-finite lemma.
Derive the units exact sequence and the Leray inclusion to identify the kernel.
Dispatch the different-components case by surjectivity of ab^{-1}.
Dispatch the proper same-component case by the scalar-valued regular functions.

Every step is present with no omissions. H2: a standard cohomological bookkeeping with a clean two-case ending.
